# BTicino C300X Integration v2.0.0

## Unreleased

## Fixed

- Send a complete 20 ms PCMU silence frame when the microphone is inactive,
  matching the RTP timestamp increment. Speex silence remains unchanged.
- Keep the agent responsive with bounded HTTP work, complete partial writes,
  queued event delivery, and non-blocking QML maintenance and GUI reload jobs.
- Make event registration, camera sessions, card reconfiguration, and entry
  cleanup safe across unload and reload. Ignore late message refresh results
  from replaced runtimes and avoid duplicate watchdog recovery commands.
- Bound stored-media downloads and conversions, support byte-range playback,
  and reuse short-lived media and message caches.
- Stop memory-diagnostic collection when debug logging is disabled.

## Changed

- Replace `device_reboot_count` with `agent_restart_count`. Update templates
  using the old diagnostic attribute; agent restarts do not prove device reboots.
- Exclude volatile diagnostics and memo text from new Recorder history entries.
  Live values remain available; existing history and backups are not deleted.
- Expand lifecycle, browser, transport, and security tests. Include direct
  runtime dependencies in the SBOM and clarify privacy and provenance guidance.

## Validation

- Three PCMU on-demand tests of 15, 45 and 90 seconds on a C300X passed with the
  microphone inactive, including normal 60-second session renewal. No reboot
  or firmware-process restart occurred during at least 180 seconds of
  observation after each stop. Issue #55 was closed following this validation.
- The reporter's exact cold-boot, short-gap and multi-unit setup remains
  untested with this build on their device.

## Upgrade

- Includes a freshly built native agent 2.0.0. Update the device agent to
  activate the PCMU correction and agent transport improvements.
- Updating only the integration is insufficient. No firmware patch or GUI
  change is required for this correction.
- Home Assistant 2026.7 remains the minimum; validation also covers 2026.10.
  Existing integration entries can be kept.
